passes: No major resource, career decision or life lesson is generated by the trip.
The world widens immediately after Zhou Ye's quiet opening and does not read as a Zhou-centered novel.
Chen Lan's introduction of Song Nan and Xu Hang remains bounded and does not create instant intimacy or collaboration.
Ordinary material logistics carry most of the chapter: charging cable, delayed vehicle, room key, heat, food, air conditioning and return transport.
Characters are distinguishable without explicit personality explanation.
Campbell function remains ordinary-world texture rather than visible progress.
problems: Too many consecutive replies land cleanly as jokes or character beats; the group risks feeling like a well-written sitcom ensemble.
Nearly every mundane object ends up revealing character, which makes the author's selection pressure too visible.
Song Nan's focal presence is useful but sometimes turns her into a social-energy engine who receives too many responsive lines.
Tang Yu, Lin Jing and Chen Lan are all slightly too available for crisp banter; real tired group travel should contain more dead air and failed uptake.
The Xu Hang photo exchange is charming but slightly too designed as a miniature echo of reproducibility/record-keeping.
The final screen-brightness gesture is an unnecessary authored closing image.
subtractive_revision_plan: Cut roughly one third of witty or perfectly responsive dialogue.
Let at least two conversational attempts fail without replacement payoff.
Shorten the Xu Hang photo exchange so it does not become a thematic callback.
Reduce explicit character contrast during the hike/cafe split; logistics are enough.
End on an ordinary unresolved transport/eating arrangement, not a symbolic or visually neat gesture.
Do not add new emotional insight or new plot.

arc_negative_space_check.song_nan_arc_touch: ordinary-world social energy and weak-tie formation only
arc_negative_space_check.xu_hang_arc_touch: minor verification identity texture only, no transformation
